meta.name: actual-budget
meta.description: Query and manage personal finances via the official Actual Budget Node.js API. Use for budget queries, transaction imports/exports, account management, categorization, rules, schedules, and bank sync with self-hosted Actual Budget instances.

copy.tagline: 查询和管理个人预算、交易与账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 Actual Budget 管理个人财务并需要自动化操作。
copy.tagline_en: Query and manage personal budgets, transactions, and accounts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Actual Budget for personal finance and need automation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询和管理你的 Actual Budget 个人财务数据，包括查看预算、账户余额、交易记录，以及导入导出交易、管理分类、规则和计划。
howto.when: 当你要求查询或操作 Actual Budget 中的财务数据时触发，例如查看预算、账户余额、导入交易等。

say.text: 查看我本月预算的剩余金额。
say.note: Claude 会调用 API 获取当前月份的预算数据。

say.text: 导入一笔新的交易到我的支票账户。
帮我创建一个每月重复的订阅计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query and manage your Actual Budget personal finance data, including viewing budgets, account balances, transactions, importing/exporting transactions, managing categories, rules, and schedules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to query or operate on Actual Budget financial data, such as viewing budgets, account balances, importing transactions, etc.

say_en.text: Show me the remaining budget for this month.
say_en.note: Claude will call the API to get the current month's budget data.

say_en.text: Import a new transaction into my checking account.
say_en.note: Claude will use importTransactions to add the transaction.

say_en.text: Create a monthly recurring subscription schedule.
say_en.note: Claude will call createSchedule to set up the recurring schedule.
